gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-jura: Jura draws its strokes like bent wire, with s curves that open wide at both ends, and it stays quiet underneath. Comic Relief, the display heading above it, makes the whole thing feel louder.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-k2d: Comic Relief is bold and commanding, with strokes that look the same whether they run up or across. And K2D follows with tube-like lines and c terminals that hang far from the bowl.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-kantumruy-pro: Loud meets friendly here. Kantumruy Pro has an e whose eye opens clearly to the right, and shrinking Comic Relief would waste its command.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-kodchasan: Comic Relief has bowls that stop short on one side, which gives every heading a hand-cut swagger. Kodchasan takes over with terminals that hang open and no calligraphic thinning, so the text feels clean beside it.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-koho: KoHo reads clean and neutral, with wide c apertures that let each word breathe. But Comic Relief, bold and commanding, belongs up big and brief, where its uniform strokes can stand out.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-kosugi-maru: Kosugi Maru reads like neon tubing, one glowing line thickness with stroke ends set far apart. And the body size can go up or down freely, since Comic Relief carries the loud part.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-livvic: Loud on top, friendly below. Comic Relief hits hardest as a bold, commanding display heading, while Livvic does its best work with unstressed curves and a generous opening in c.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-m-plus-1p: Comic Relief draws strokes like fine rope laid into letter shapes, bold and commanding. But M PLUS 1p is the one that stays open at every curve end, quietly doing the reading.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-m-plus-code-latin: Approachable, first of all, despite the loud heading. M PLUS Code Latin bends neon tubing into letters of constant thickness, and its pitcher-mouth c is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-comic-relief-gf-manjari: Bold, commanding Comic Relief shows no difference between its up and side strokes, and it leads with real confidence. Manjari's wide, unclosed terminals keep the text approachable.
